tools.name: scripts/verify_head.py
tools.description: Checks a daily head's Ed25519 signature against kd-passport-1 from https://karmadue.expo.app/.well-known/jwks.json.

tools.name: scripts/check_order.py
tools.description: Checks that seq never goes down across heads/.

permissions: contents:write (daily-anchor workflow only, to commit heads/YYYY-MM-DD.json)
id-token:write (scorecard workflow only, to publish OpenSSF Scorecard results)
humanApprovalRequiredFor: changes to scripts and workflows (made only by the repository owner)

policies.retention: Append-only. Each daily anchor (hashes, counts, timestamps, signatures; no personal data) is kept indefinitely.
